Frequency once per encounter

Area 30-foot burst centred on a creature you Strike

Saving Throw Will

Make a ranged Strike from a position no enemy has identified. Whether it hits or not, every enemy in the area attempts a Will save against your class DC; on a failure it is frightened 1 and cannot Stride toward the direction of the shot until the end of its next turn, and on a critical failure it is frightened 2 and must take cover on its turn if any is available.
